title: test_api_gaps.rs: documented API issues (compile_fail + runtime)
description:
Write tests/test_api_gaps.rs: document all API issues from PR #10248 and #10305 review as compile_fail doc-tests and runtime assertions.

## What
Create a permanent, executable registry of API breaking changes, missing types, and logic bugs found during the PR review.

## Algorithm
1. LMS sigs_left() rename (PR #10305, lms.rs):
   - Add a compile_fail doc-test: ///  with comment: 'sigs_left() was renamed to has_sigs_left() in PR #10305; no deprecation shim; see wolfssl/wolfssl#10305'
2. mlkem encode_public_key return type (PR #10305, mlkem.rs):
   - compile_fail doc-test: code that expects usize from encode_public_key(); comment: 'return type changed from Result<usize,i32> to Result<(),i32> in PR #10305, breaking change'
3. Missing Aes192Gcm and Aes192Ccm:
   - compile_fail doc-test: 'use wolfssl_wolfcrypt::aes::Aes192Gcm;' with comment: 'AES-192-GCM is missing; only 128 and 256 bit key sizes are implemented'
4. CMAC/HMAC Mac not Clone or Reset:
   - compile_fail doc-test: code calling .clone() on a CmacAes128 instance; comment: 'digest::Mac implementors should ideally implement Clone+Reset for stateful use; PR #10305 does not'
5. ecc::ECC::verify result fix (PR #10305 bug fix: res != 0 → res == 1):
   - Runtime test using a known-valid ECDSA P-256 signature from Wycheproof and a known-invalid (bit-flipped) signature
   - Verify valid returns Ok(true), invalid returns Ok(false) or Err (not Ok(true) with wrong logic)
   - Comment: 'This test guards against regression to the pre-PR-#10305 bug where any non-zero rc was treated as success'

## Defensive rules
- Each gap entry must have: (a) the PR number that introduced or fixes it, (b) the file and line in wolfssl-wolfcrypt where the issue occurs, (c) the user impact (compile break? silent wrong answer? missing functionality?)
- compile_fail tests must include the exact error message expected in the comment so future readers know what to look for
- This file must compile successfully even when PR #10248 and #10305 are absent (use cfg-guarded or doc-test-only forms)
- Add a module-level comment stating: 'This file is a living registry. When a gap is fixed in wolfssl-wolfcrypt, move the compile_fail test to a passing test.'

## Agent team
- Agent R: re-read PR #10305 diff for lms.rs, mlkem.rs, ecc.rs to confirm exact method/type names for gaps 1, 2, 5; re-read PR #10248 for aes.rs Aes192Gcm absence
- Agent I: write test_api_gaps.rs per algorithm above
- Agent T: verify each compile_fail test actually fails to compile (by temporarily removing the compile_fail attribute and confirming the error); verify the ecc verify runtime test has a real ECDSA vector, not a synthetic one

## Tests (oracles)
- ecc verify bug: Wycheproof ecdsa_secp256r1_sha256_test.json (one valid + one invalid vector)
- All compile_fail expectations: Rust compiler errors from wolfssl-wolfcrypt crate
